brand.name: Engwish
brand.logo_instructions: Create a React component for the logo: A circular div (w-12 h-12) split horizontally (top half #FF0033, bottom half #000000) containing a stylized white 'E'. Beside it, text 'ENGWISH' in uppercase bold sans-serif, with 'SKILLS ACADEMY' below it, separated by a thin red line.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly implement a 'dark mode only' glossy red glassmorphism aesthetic.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use any pictures of females. Do NOT use flags of any country. Rely entirely on the provided image URLs.
Implement a 3D slider for showcasing features/courses in the hero or about section (e.g., Swiper with effect='coverflow').
Add 'exploring objects' floating animations for abstract 3D elements (use framer-motion to animate floating spheres/shapes).
Build a persistent floating WhatsApp click-to-chat button (bottom right).
Create the Hero, About, 4 Courses, Testimonials, and Contact sections on the main page, PLUS separate detail pages for the 4 courses.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-button').
Ensure typography uses Clash Display for headings and Outfit for body (install via Google Fonts).
